# Integrate UHI

The calls themselves: where they live, what they need in their headers, every operation, and one request written out in full.

## Hosts

- `https://api.eka.care` Production
- `https://api.dev.eka.care` Stage/Sandbox

## Auth and headers

Get a token first: [Authentication](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/auth/getting-started).

- `authApiKey`: HTTP bearer. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Endpoints

20 operations, grouped by tag.

### Blood Bank

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | [`/abdm/uhi/v1/blood-bank/search`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/uhi/blood-bank/state-district) | State District |
| `GET` | [`/abdm/uhi/v1/blood-bank/search/{request_id}`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/uhi/blood-bank/get-blood-banks) | Get Blood Banks |

## One request in full

POST /abdm/uhi/v1/blood-bank/search, from [its page](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/uhi/blood-bank/state-district).

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.eka.care/abdm/uhi/v1/blood-bank/search' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
